mapper.select: SELECT cm.comment_id, cm.post_id, cm.member_id, m.nickname, cm.content, cm.created_at FROM comment cm JOIN member m ON m.member_id = cm.member_id WHERE cm.post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY cm.comment_id
SELECT cm.comment_id, cm.post_id, cm.member_id, m.nickname, cm.content, cm.created_at FROM comment cm JOIN member m ON m.member_id = cm.member_id WHERE cm.comment_id = #{commentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment (post_id, member_id, content) VALUES (#{postId}, #{memberId}, #{content})
